scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.compose:config:production: BAP_PUBLIC_HOST=bap.invalid BAP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=https://bap.invalid docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.production.yaml config --quiet
scripts.compose:verify: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.development.yaml config --format json | node scripts/verify-compose.mjs development && BAP_PUBLIC_HOST=bap.invalid BAP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=https://bap.invalid docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.production.yaml config --format json | node scripts/verify-compose.mjs production && BAP_PUBLIC_HOST=bap.invalid BAP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=https://bap.invalid docker compose --profile operations -f compose.yaml -f compose.production.yaml config --format json | node scripts/verify-compose.mjs operations && docker compose --profile bootstrap -f compose.yaml -f compose.development.yaml config --format json | node scripts/verify-compose.mjs bootstrap
